entities.summary: Nelly Butete Kashumba Mutti is a Zambian lawyer and politician who has been the 7th Speaker of the National Assembly of Zambia since 2021, and is the first woman to hold that role. She was elected vice president of the Inter-Parliamentary Union in 2025.
